title: Use the Prefix
prompt: Compute the square root of 225 using the math module and print it (one line).

tests.name: sqrt via math
tests.code:
assert printed[0] == "15.0", f"got {printed}"
assert "import math" in code, "import the math module"
assert "math.sqrt" in code, "use math.sqrt — the canonical square-root function"
